title: Settings
subtitle: General application settings

resume.title: Resume
resume.description: PDF resume file used for job applications

credentials.title: Account Credentials
credentials.description: Used for creating accounts on external ATS platforms during applications. Stored locally in plaintext. Prefer using SSO (Sign in with LinkedIn/Google) when possible.

agent.title: Agent Settings
agent.maxFailuresDesc: Agent stops trying after this many consecutive failures on a single job.

telemetry.title: Privacy & Telemetry
telemetry.description: Help improve LangHireV2 by sending anonymous usage data (feature usage, crash reports). No personal information or job data is transmitted.

blockedDomains.title: Blocked Domains
blockedDomains.description: Jobs on these domains will be automatically skipped.

plugins.title: Job Source Plugins
plugins.description: Manage job source plugins. Built-in plugins provide LinkedIn, Indeed, Glassdoor, Handshake, ZipRecruiter, Intern Insider, Reed, StepStone, SEEK and Naukri. Import community plugins (.yaml files) for additional job sites.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: Choose light, dark, or follow your system setting.

aiModelHint: The AI model has its own Save button.
tailoringHint: Saved as you change them. Review & Apply uses them when it tailors a resume.
inboxHint: How often the Inbox reads job emails from Gmail by itself. Saved as you change it.
